title: Round Table Foundation ELF research penetrating a Faraday cage

tellings.quote: frequency that can he figured out like penetrate the walls of a Faraday cage.

plain: At the Round Table Foundation, a private research lab, a researcher named Andrija Puharich is said to have found a very low radio frequency that could pass through the walls of a Faraday cage, a metal enclosure built to block electrical signals. The researcher Greg Malatzi tells Michels this, without naming a source. If true, it would mean signals could reach a person even inside a shielded room.
